name: Le Meridien Central Park New York
positioning: Le Meridien New York, Central Park: a Midtown Manhattan hotel on West 57th Street, two blocks south of Central Park, with a rooftop bar and a French brasserie
best_for: Travelers who want a Midtown base within walking distance of Central Park, Carnegie Hall and Broadway
Guests who want a room with a private balcony or a suite with Central Park views

facts.text: The hotel sits on West 57th Street between 6th and 7th Avenues in Midtown Manhattan.
Carnegie Hall, Rockefeller Center, MoMA and Columbus Circle are all within reach of the hotel.
Central Park, Carnegie Hall, Fifth Avenue, Rockefeller Center and Broadway are all within walking distance.
Paris Bar is a French brasserie at ground level serving traditional French cuisine.
Bathrooms are marble, with Malin and Goetz bath amenities.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and many offer Midtown Manhattan views.
Rooms have a coffee and tea station with Illy coffee.
Le Meridien Hub is a modern reinterpretation of the traditional hotel lobby, a place for guests to gather and connect.
The concierge team helps with things from an umbrella on a rainy day to a personalized Manhattan itinerary.
The fitness center has the latest cardio and strength-training equipment.
The hotel holds LEED New Construction certification.
Pets are welcome, up to 2 per room.

highlights.text: Each Terrace King room has a private balcony overlooking 57th Street.
Le Jardin Rooftop Bar has views of Central Park and the city skyline, with drinks and light bites.
The hotel is two blocks south of Central Park.
The Park Suites offer views of Central Park.
The Penthouse Suite has two bedrooms, a spacious common area and sweeping views of Central Park.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
Self-parking is off-site at GMC Garage on West 56th Street.
